review_description: Company has de-registered. Cannot contact anyone for insurance purposes, system is only 4 years old and 75% damaged. Company is no longer trading and i am stuck with a $10000 solar panel system that i cannot get help with. All phone numbers and contact numbers do not work.

From quote to cleanup, Ardson were marvellous and easy to work with.All aspects and extras were carefully and accurately explained with no "hidden surprises" !Altogether a stress less experience with a swell sales-lady with all the knowledge and some more.Electrical work was explained and carried out with neatness and professionalism.A big thankyou to Debra and Ardson and Ryan the "sparkie".
I really like the one-brand idea and this is the only company that could offer me this peace of mind. Thank you for your professionalism
